== Template:Item/DPS ==

Calculates and displays weapon DPS (Damage Per Second).

=== DPS Calculation ===

* '''Normal weapons:''' DPS = damage / delay
* '''2-Handed weapons:''' DPS = (damage / delay) × 2
* Result is rounded up (ceiling function)

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Description
|-
| '''damage''' || Yes || Weapon damage value
|-
| '''delay''' || Yes || Weapon attack delay in seconds
|-
| '''type''' || Yes || Weapon type (use "Primary - 2-Handed" for 2x damage modifier)
|}

=== Examples ===

'''2-Handed Weapon:'''
<pre>
{{Item/DPS
|damage=50
|delay=3
|type=Primary - 2-Handed
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/DPS
|damage=50
|delay=3
|type=Primary - 2-Handed
}}

----

'''Normal Weapon:'''
<pre>
{{Item/DPS
|damage=30
|delay=2
|type=Primary
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/DPS
|damage=30
|delay=2
|type=Primary
}}

----
